== Description ==

[[Taylor Gosiaco]] (right, glasses, short dark hair, navy shirt, watch, smiling, hands together) and [[Joe Phillips]] (left, tan cap, white long-sleeve over a dark shirt, in profile) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
